principle: No target/property variables, proxy labels, or provenance identifiers may enter similarity features.

composition.transform: chemistry-aware stoichiometric fractions plus element-aware distance

physical_form.transform: normalized controlled vocabulary plus unknown-hot encoding

fabrication.transform: ordered-step tokens where available; otherwise normalized multi-hot categories

state_and_morphology.transform: unit-normalized numeric values; missingness masks control distance availability but do not act as scientific descriptors

holdout_only.MaterialFamily: exploratory taxonomy sensitivity only; never a confirmatory label
holdout_only.DOI: paper identity and bibliographic enrichment key

context_proxy_rules.same_paper: Primary weak-positive support via SID; DOI is a consistency/sensitivity identifier.
context_proxy_rules.same_institution: Secondary weak-positive support only across different papers; resolve to normalized organization IDs.
context_proxy_rules.not_negative: Different paper, author, or institution means unlabeled, never dissimilar.
context_proxy_rules.no_expert_labels: Expert scoring and expert-defined cluster labels are outside the first study.

missingness.default: pairwise block masking with denominator renormalization and zero missingness penalty
missingness.warning: Missingness fingerprints can encode paper, curator, or institution and must not be treated as scientific similarity without a leakage analysis.
